column1: # L278: every gate's CONTRACT and FAMILY -- the coverage matrix's one source (tools/coverage_matrix.py checks it
# against the Makefile in host-checks).  A gate is a make target (or a runner sub-gate, `runner:<name>`).
#   contract   session | loader | spec (greedy == spec, multi-bank verify) | spec-dist (the sampled distribution)
#              | reference | chat | server | tp | kernel:<name>; a gate checking several lists them, comma-separated
#   family     deepseek4 | qwen4_exp | nemotron_h | gemma4 | all (family-neutral: runs for every family, or needs no model)
#   tier       battery (make gates) | dev (gates-dev only) | manual (neither; say why in the note)
# A family in the registry (src/engine/family.cpp) that this matrix does not track is an `untracked` row, naming the
# ledger row that closes it: untracked, family, Lnnn, note.
# A contract x family cell with no battery gate must appear as a `gap` row naming the ledger row that closes it --
# the check fails on an undeclared hole, so a gap is written down, not remembered.
# L284: a gate listed for ONE family (a kernel: gate excepted) is a decision for every other family, written down
# below the table as one of
#   na   <target> <family> <reason>          the contract does not apply there: the family lacks, by design, the
#                                            mechanism the gate grades (and what grades the family's own instead)
#   gap  <target> <family> <Lnnn> <note>     it applies and is owed; the ledger row that closes it
# and the check fails on a one-family gate with neither, or on such a row for a gate that already runs there.
